label: SS18::SSX4

sections.text: SS18 encodes a component of the BAF chromatin-remodeling complex.
SSX4 encodes a cancer-testis antigen with transcriptional regulatory activity.

The fusion replaces the SS18 carboxy terminus with SSX sequences and redirects BAF chromatin-remodeling complexes, activating an oncogenic transcriptional program. It is a defining molecular alteration of synovial sarcoma.

Afamitresgene autoleucel is US-approved for adults with unresectable or metastatic synovial sarcoma after chemotherapy who have one of the specified HLA-A*02 alleles and whose tumors express MAGE-A4. SS18::SSX detection alone does not establish cellular-therapy eligibility.
